title: Not For Us
text: Not For Us. First, I have a large family. So any vacuum we have is really going to have to work very hard. We've got 2 adults, 8 kids, and 2 dogs for this thing to contend with. I love that the wall hook is super small. The battery is enough for one floor of my house on one charge. The suction power is okay. I'd say it is adequate. Definitely not deep cleaning, but getting the surface stuff well enough. It makes vacuuming stairs very easy. It is lightweight. I like the filter. I do not like that the button to release the dirty bin broke week one, making it impossible to remove the dirt bin. (We have to empty it by opening the bin while it is attached to the handle.) The roller is pretty weak and doesn't do much. It doesn't clean as well as a standard sized plug into the wall vacuum. For quick stuff, for stairs, for cleaning under couch cushions-- it works fine. It definitely isn't enough vacuum for us.

description: We know you value a clean home and Eureka is proud to offer whole home cleaning solutions to make life a little easier.

Eureka Lightweight Cordless Stick Vacuum is the ultimate portable vacuum cleaner for home living! Say goodbye to pesky cords and hello to wireless cleaning freedom. Our fingertip control allows you to effortlessly switch between different gears for efficient cleaning on all surfaces. The lightweight design and convenient wall mount make storage of this dorm room essential easily.

The dust cup located at the top makes this vacuum easy to empty and allowing you to reach even the deepest spots and corners in your apartment. Don't settle for less - Invest in our tiny vacuum today and enjoy a tidier, cleaner home!
